description: Source code for WebSocketDeflater class implementing compression/decompression using zlib in the net namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflater
classes.description: Class implementing WebSocket deflation using zlib, managing compression streams and buffers.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the deflater with specified window bits, setting up zlib stream.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds data bytes to the deflater for compression.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Finalizes compression, flushing remaining data and removing tail bytes.

methods.name: PushSyncMark
methods.description: Inserts a synchronization mark into the buffer.

methods.name: GetOutput
methods.description: Retrieves compressed output of specified size.

methods.name: ResetContext
methods.description: Resets the zlib deflate stream context based on mode.

methods.name: Deflate
methods.description: Performs deflation (compression) on the data in the stream.
